title: SCE may shut off our power Thu 6 AM – Fri 9 PM
text:
⚡ Possible power shutoff — our circuit (Orion)
SCE has our circuit on its list for a possible wildfire-safety shutoff, Thu, Oct 15, 6 AM to Fri, Oct 16, 9 PM. It isn’t certain yet: SCE decides from the actual wind.
Charge phones, power banks and home batteries before then, and know how to open your garage door by hand. If someone at home relies on powered medical equipment, plan for that now.
SCE status: sce.com/outagemap
Live info: https://tesorohighlands.com/fire
